text:
Alex: Bringing up a HF checkpoint (chat-style) and ran into a couple of config mismatches during conversion. converter crashes on KV head count and generation clips because max_position_embeddings is too small. anyone seen this exact combo?

Mia: yup. common when HF config uses num_key_value_heads != num_attention_heads / heads_per_kv. converter assumes kv heads already folded. quick question: is this a quantized build or FP32? :thinking_face:

Alex: FP32 for now. huggingface config.json snippet attached in the job output: 
```json
{
  "hidden_size": 2048,
  "num_attention_heads": 64,
  "num_key_value_heads": 32,
  "max_position_embeddings": 2048,
  "rope_scaling": { "type": "linear", "factor": 1.2 },
  "sliding_window": 256
}
```

Sam: error log from converter (short):
```
RuntimeError: KV cache head mismatch: model expects 64, checkpoint has 32
 during load_state_dict
```

Sam: converter should detect num_key_value_heads and auto-upgrade state keys to match runtime layout, but ours only has a heuristic. filing a conversion rule.

Julian: two things to watch: 1) max_position_embeddings often underprovisioned in HF snapshots if they used ALiBi or sliding windows in pretraining. 2) rope_scaling keys vary: HF uses {type, factor} but our runtime expects {mode, alpha} -> mapping bug.

Mia: workaround steps that worked for me:
- override num_key_value_heads at conversion time to num_attention_heads (if kv is fused)
- bump max_position_embeddings to what the tokenizer uses (or enable sliding_window runtime)
- translate rope_scaling -> runtime format

Example quick patch I ran locally (converter CLI):
```
./bin/hf2rw \ 
  --checkpoint ./hf_ckpt \ 
  --out ./rw_model \ 
  --override num_key_value_heads=64 \ 
  --override max_position_embeddings=4096 \ 
  --rope-map '{"type":"linear","factor":1.2}->{"mode":"linear","alpha":1.2}'
```

Alex: nice. on the tokenizer side we also saw the chat template mismatch: HF saved prompt template as {\"system\":...,\"roles\": [\"assistant\"]} while Redwood expects 'chat_template' with instruct/system tags, so inference shoves system token into user history and quality suffers.

Julian: yeah, we should add a converter rule: if 'chat' style present, map HF keys to rw_chat fields and ensure special_tokens: {"bos","eos","sep","pad"} are set. Also validate tokenizer.vocab_size against max_position_embeddings (warn when vocab uses special long-context tokens).

model-bot: conversion-job 84321 failed: exit_code=1, reason=KV_HEAD_MISMATCH. See logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/84321/logs

Mia: I can put together a small RFC for the converter heuristics: auto-translate rope_scaling, accept num_key_value_heads override, warn on max_position_embeddings < tokenizer.model_max_length, and standardize chat template mapping. anyone want to pair on tests? :white_check_mark:

Sam: I can add unit tests for the state-dict remapping (simulate fused vs unfused kv layouts). will also test CPU load with different kv head counts to ensure inference path picks correct kernel.

Alex: thanks. I'll attach the failing checkpoint to the ticket and add a short repro script. marking this thread follow-up -> TICKET-1227. will update when converter patch lands. :thumbsup:

Julian: for the immediate prod deploy, recommended hotfix: convert with overrides, run smoke eval on rouge/bleu and chat-sanity prompts, then ship. don't forget to re-run quantized conversion if we change head counts.

Alex: got it. closing the loop here. will ping when patch merged.
